fact_check_verdict: Core survives with hedges. KCAW is sole source for 'unanimous' and 'all zones'; Sentinel corroborates direction ('Planners Vote Down Data Centers for Now'), minutes unposted. Draft/memo/utility figures from City of Sitka primaries. CUT: vote tally, Assembly date, per-facility GW norms, any Sitka spare-capacity claim, nameplate MW, any state-law claim, Anchorage position, private commenter assertions. It is a recommendation, not law.

claims.spoken: On October twenty first, Sitka's planning commission voted unanimously to recommend banning data centers in every zone, per K C A W.
claims.on_screen: RECOMMENDED · A BAN IN EVERY ZONE
requires: A RECOMMENDATION to the Assembly, never a law and never 'Sitka banned'. Unanimous and all zones are KCAW's reporting, attribute to KCAW.
claims.verbatim_source: "Ultimately the Planning Commission unanimously agreed to recommend defining data centers in city code"

claims.spoken: The city's own draft would have allowed them, but only with a conditional use permit.
requires: Say the city's draft, not the commission's.
claims.verbatim_source: "The proposed amendment would allow data center construction only with a conditional use permit."

claims.spoken: Staff wrote that the draft does not propose prohibiting data centers.
claims.on_screen: STAFF DID NOT PROPOSE A BAN
requires: Attribute to the city staff memo of October sixteenth.
claims.verbatim_source: "This zoning text amendment does not propose prohibiting data centers"

claims.spoken: The city's sustainability commission had backed the permit route, unanimously, on October fifth.
requires: Ordinal date, no year.
claims.verbatim_source: "At their October 5, 2026 regular meeting, the Sustainability Commission unanimously recommended"

claims.spoken: Nobody has proposed a data center in Sitka, and the city code doesn't even define one.
claims.on_screen: NO DATA CENTER PROPOSED IN SITKA
requires: Preemptive zoning. Never imply a developer is at the door.
claims.verbatim_source: KCAW: Sitka has no public proposal and its code does not address data centers (field: paraphrase).

claims.spoken: The city memo says machine learning and A I have spurred rapid growth in the sector.
claims.on_screen: AI SPURRED THE GROWTH · PER CITY MEMO
requires: AI is context only. No AI company or project is involved in Sitka.
claims.verbatim_source: "the development of machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) has spurred rapid growth and expansion of the sector recently."

claims.spoken: Sitka's grid is an island, powered entirely by water.
requires: Say hydropower or water, never 'renewable only' beyond the memo.
claims.verbatim_source: "As an islanded electric grid supplied entirely by hydroelectric power"

claims.spoken: The city memo calls a small, power hungry data center here not entirely unlikely.
requires: Quote only, attribute to the memo.
claims.verbatim_source: "the possibility of a small footprint, large electric consumption data center being proposed in Sitka is not entirely unlikely."

claims.spoken: Sitka's record peak demand is twenty six megawatts, set last December.
requires: December twenty third, 2025. Instantaneous peak per the utility annual report.
claims.verbatim_source: "an instantaneous demand of 26.02 MW"

claims.spoken: The memo calls a data center over twenty megawatts hyperscale.
requires: Typically over 20 MW, the memo's wording.
claims.verbatim_source: "(sometimes referred to as hyperscale, typically >20 MW)"

claims.spoken: One gigawatt is about thirty eight times Sitka's record peak.
claims.on_screen: 1 GW IS ABOUT 38 TIMES THAT PEAK
requires: Derived arithmetic: 1000 divided by 26.02. Label it as our math. No source proposes a gigawatt project in Sitka.
claims.verbatim_source: derived: 1000 MW / 26.02 MW = 38.4 (labelled non-quotation)

claims.spoken: The draft's definition sets no size line, so a lab and a hyperscale campus are both a data center.
claims.on_screen: THE DRAFT'S DEFINITION HAS NO SIZE LINE
requires: The definition carves out only a local server room used with other permitted uses.
claims.verbatim_source: "A data center is not a server rack or room that is used to store and/or access data that is produced locally"

claims.spoken: A commissioner, Dmitry Rudas, warned that one kilowatt, one megawatt and one gigawatt are very different things under one word.
requires: KCAW paraphrase. NO quote marks on the kilowatt, megawatt, gigawatt line. Use the surname, no pronoun.
claims.verbatim_source: KCAW paraphrase: Rudas compared a one-kilowatt home lab to a one-megawatt data center and a one-gigawatt hyperscale facility (labelled non-quotation).

claims.spoken: Lisa Sadlier-Hart told the commission, we need to say it loud, and we need to say it now.
claims.on_screen: "WE NEED TO SAY IT LOUD, AND WE NEED TO SAY IT NOW" · LISA SADLIER-HART
requires: Straight quote, attribute to Sadlier-Hart in public testimony.
claims.verbatim_source: "We need to say it loud, and we need to say it now."

claims.spoken: Aurora Taylor of the sustainability commission said they hope to build a pathway for local regulation and local input.
claims.on_screen: "LOCAL REGULATION AND LOCAL INPUT" · AURORA TAYLOR
requires: Quote ends at 'local input'. Surname, no pronoun.
claims.verbatim_source: "We are really hoping to establish a pathway for local regulation and local input"

claims.spoken: Commissioner Jacquie Foss said a permit could someday allow something good, but she couldn't yet say what the conditions would be.
requires: Use the surname only, no pronoun. Paraphrase, no quote marks.
claims.verbatim_source: "I see conditional uses as an opportunity to allow things that may be beneficial to the town of Sitka"

claims.spoken: The recommendation goes to the Sitka Assembly at a meeting not yet set.
claims.on_screen: NEXT · THE SITKA ASSEMBLY · DATE NOT SET
requires: No date. It is not on the October 27th Assembly agenda.
claims.verbatim_source: "The commission's recommendation will go to the Sitka Assembly for consideration at a future meeting."

claims.spoken: Sitka's hydro plants made one hundred twenty gigawatt hours last year, and the town used one hundred eighteen.
requires: Calendar year 2025. Hydro varies with rainfall, never imply spare capacity.
claims.verbatim_source: "In 2025, Sitka's hydropower generated 120 GWh of electricity"; "In 2025, Sitka Consumed 118 GWh"

claims.spoken: In Cordova, a data center the size of a large refrigerator, one hundred fifty kilowatts, runs at a hydro plant.
requires: Per the city memo, installed 2024 at Humpback Creek. Say per the city memo.
claims.verbatim_source: "a modular 150-kW, edge-computing data center the size of a large refrigerator, was installed in Cordova's Humpback Creek Hydro Facility powerhouse."

claims.spoken: The memo also notes a data center proposed in Petersburg and one recently denied in Wrangell.
requires: As stated in the city memo, not independently fetched.
claims.verbatim_source: "with a data center proposed in Petersburg and a recently denied facility in Wrangell"

claims.spoken: In Fairbanks, the mayor has filed a moratorium on large data center permits through the end of twenty twenty seven.
requires: Proposed, referred to the Planning Commission, not adopted. Never say Fairbanks banned.
claims.verbatim_source: "An Ordinance Establishing A Temporary Moratorium On Land Use Permits For Large Scale Data Centers"

claims.spoken: Fairbanks draws its line at five megawatts of demand.
requires: Thresholds include 5 MW peak demand, per Alaska's News Source quoting the ordinance.
Draw the tick DASHED and tag it PROPOSED.
claims.verbatim_source: "an aggregate peak electrical demand of five megawatts (5 MW) or greater"

claims.spoken: A U A F guide says it plainly, data centers are not all the same.
claims.on_screen: "DATA CENTERS ARE NOT ALL THE SAME" · UAF ACEP GUIDE
requires: Attribute to the guide's description on Zenodo, not to a person.
claims.verbatim_source: "Data centers are not all the same."

claims.spoken: Sitka has about eight thousand people.
requires: 2025 state estimate, 8,032.
claims.verbatim_source: Row 'Sitka, City and Borough' = 8,032 (field citation)
